Bhiwadi is one of the NCR's busiest industrial towns — the RIICO estates at Bhiwadi, Khushkhera, and Chopanki are full of auto-ancillary, steel, and engineering units, and they keep work going that needs site offices, gate cabins, and supervisor rooms. SAMAN builds those cabins. We manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and run them across to Bhiwadi in 3 to 5 days, ready to set on your plinth. Whether you need a guard cabin at a RIICO plot or a multi-room contractor office on a Khushkhera site, for a porta cabin in Bhiwadi just call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we'll quote it.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

Search "porta cabin in Bhiwadi" and you mostly get IndiaMART supplier cards — prices from around ₹780 a square foot up past ₹3 lakh for a finished unit, and not much to choose between sellers. The cards rarely state the steel grade, the panel thickness, or how the cabin's anchored. For a RIICO auto-ancillary plot or a Chopanki site that runs for years, that's the detail that decides whether the cabin holds up.

We make the porta cabins ourselves, so when you call you reach the people who build them. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • A frame in IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections — welded, primed, powder-coated, then anchor-bolted to your plinth so it stays put.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls — insulation that handles the dry Rajasthan heat and the NCR winter both.
  • A colour-coated GI roof, pitched for the monsoon, with a false ceiling under it.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points and tube-light provision.

The paperwork is real. ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS is Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, and Bhiwadi sits on a short run from our Greater Noida factory.

Delivery runs ₹3,000 standard, transit to Bhiwadi is 3–5 days, and returns are 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Bhiwadi

Bhiwadi's RIICO belt decides what cabin a buyer needs, and the estates each pull different work:

RIICO Industrial Area Bhiwadi (PIN 301019) — the main estate, phases spread across the town, packed with auto-ancillary, steel, and engineering units. Steady demand for gate security cabins and supervisor offices, with multi-room blocks on the larger plots.

Khushkhera RIICO Industrial Area (PIN 301019) — the big auto and component belt toward Tapukara, home to large plants and their vendors. Contractor offices, worker accommodation, and security cabins, often several at once on expansion and shutdown work.

Chopanki RIICO Industrial Area (PIN 301707) — the estate on the Bhiwadi-Tapukara stretch with steel, fabrication, and engineering units. Site offices, stores, and gate cabins through project and build phases.

Beyond the estates there's the construction side: warehouse parks feeding Delhi NCR, the Bhiwadi-Tapukara-Neemrana corridor, and housing. All of it runs on porta cabins as the site office and the gate.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida across to the Bhiwadi belt, it's a short 3–5 day run from our factory. It's part of the same NCR industrial belt we cover with our porta cabin in Manesar and porta cabin in Sonipat work.

What You're Actually Getting — Specifications

Built for the dry Rajasthan heat and the NCR monsoon and winter.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded and zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel as standard — insulation that holds against the Bhiwadi heat. Cement board for a tougher skin on a long industrial posting.

Roof: colour-coated GI sheet, pitched for drainage, false ceiling underneath. Turbo ventilators for open plots with no shade — common on the RIICO estates.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate for a sit-down office.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, with sealed louvre or sliding windows to keep estate dust out. Fixed glazing on request. All fitted at the factory.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Sizes off the shelf: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, 10×40 (the 40 ft block). Odd size? We'll build to it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, a full multi-room block, with an attached toilet or a pantry if you need one.

What People in Bhiwadi Use Them For

  • Gate security cabins at RIICO, Khushkhera, and Chopanki plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices on auto-plant and component-vendor projects
  • Portable office cabins and supervisor rooms at RIICO units
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the larger project and expansion sites
  • Site stores for tools and material at project yards
  • Site-management offices on warehouse and corridor construction

Customising It to Your Site

Most orders aren't the bare standard. Common changes:

  • Custom size and multi-room layouts
  • Sealed windows and doors for dust-heavy RIICO plots
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for a summer office
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for open, shadeless plots
  • Internal partitions, extra doors or windows
  • Plumbing run for an attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where the load numbers allow

Tell us the plot and the use; we'll confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Bhiwadi

On the marketplaces you'll see Bhiwadi prices from around ₹780–₹1,250 a square foot, and finished units from about ₹2.5 lakh up past ₹3 lakh. The spread is wide because no two cabins are the same. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room is the floor, a 10×40 block the ceiling.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a tougher build.
  3. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  4. Dust-and-heat kit — sealed windows, ventilator, AC provision as the plot needs.
  5. Quantity — order five or more and the per-unit price comes down.

For a real number on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Bhiwadi Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it across to the Bhiwadi belt — a short haul. Three to five days in transit. When it lands, we set it on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block takes about a day to settle. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard — ask for a combined rate if you're taking several. It's the same factory-direct network behind the porta cabins we deliver across Faridabad and the NCR. One thing to be clear about: we don't have a yard or branch in Bhiwadi. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked straight to your plot.

Looking After It

A SAMAN cabin needs very little. Wash the estate dust off the panels now and then, keep the roof drains clear before the monsoon, and check the door and window fittings once a year. The powder-coated MS frame and GI roof take years of site use with that light attention — no annual repainting, no special upkeep.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Bhiwadi

Do you deliver porta cabins to RIICO, Khushkhera, and Chopanki?

Yes — RIICO Bhiwadi, Khushkhera, Chopanki, and construction sites across the Bhiwadi belt. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory and takes 3–5 days, since Bhiwadi is a short run. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

What does a porta cabin cost in Bhiwadi?

Marketplace listings run around ₹780–₹1,250 a square foot, with finished units from about ₹2.5 lakh — but the real number depends on size, panel type, fit-out and quantity. We quote against your exact spec rather than publish a fixed price. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

What sizes and layouts can I get?

Stock sizes run 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, and 10×40 ft, in single-room, two-room, or full multi-room layouts, with an attached toilet or pantry on request. Need an odd size? We build to it.

Can you supply multiple cabins for a RIICO plant project?

Yes. We supply contractors and project managers, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send the project scope and we'll confirm what we can supply and by when.

How long from order to delivery in Bhiwadi?

Transit is 3–5 days once the cabin's built, since Bhiwadi is a short run from Greater Noida. Production time depends on the configuration and your place in the queue — standard sizes move quicker. We'll give you a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Bhiwadi

Need a porta cabin in Bhiwadi — for a RIICO plot, a Khushkhera plant project, or a corridor construction site? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or drop your requirement in the enquiry form. We'll come back with the right spec for your plot, a delivery date, and a firm price. You can also browse our custom porta cabins built for factory sites for sizes and configurations.
